raw_response:
This small piece of land is just for my beans mixed with other things my wife grows. I never went to school, but I know beans do not need the white fertilizer like maize does — my father never put it, and the beans still came. I have no spare money for fertilizer on this small plot anyway; whatever coupon I get from the government I save for my maize plot. I will put some of the goat droppings I collect from the kraal, use the seed I kept from last harvest like always, and my wife and I will weed it ourselves.
